stem: A pharmacy discovers that several unused DEA Forms 222 are missing. What is the first regulatory response?

choices.text: Immediately report the missing forms and available details to DEA.
Wait until a missing form is used before reporting it.
Report only to the form supplier.
Use DEA Form 106 as the lost-form report.
Void the serial numbers internally and take no external action.

explanation.core_reasoning: Immediately report the missing forms and available details to DEA. By contrast, 'Wait until a missing form is used before reporting it.' uses a legal trigger absent from the stem.

choice_analysis.A: The stated facts support this result: Immediately report the missing forms and available details to DEA.
choice_analysis.B: This near-miss uses a different trigger: Wait until a missing form is used before reporting it.
choice_analysis.C: This near-miss uses a different trigger: Report only to the form supplier.
choice_analysis.D: This near-miss uses a different trigger: Use DEA Form 106 as the lost-form report.
choice_analysis.E: This near-miss uses a different trigger: Void the serial numbers internally and take no external action.

related_facts: A registrant must immediately report lost or stolen used or unused DEA Forms 222 to the responsible DEA Special Agent in Charge and retain the required replacement-form statements.
explanation.mpje_trap: Reject 'Wait until a missing form is used before reporting it.' because its legal trigger is absent.
